title: Contributor ownership verification requires collaborators API access unavailable to fork contributors

labels.name: effort:low
labels.description: Mechanical, one file, no new logic (issue-worker-low)

labels.name: P5
labels.description: Agent surface and tooling keep up with what shipped

body:
## Problem

The branch-writer/reviewer ownership procedure requires a collaborators API read that an outside contributor cannot perform. This leaves no documented path for a contributor to resume requested follow-up work after a reviewer releases ownership.

Account: `seelesturm`, contributing from `seelesturm/Camcraft-NeoTech` to `NeoTech/Camcraft`.

## Required procedure

In [ownership.md](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/main/.claude/skills/issue-claims/references/ownership.md), the **Record and read** section requires verifying both the reviewer record author and the reviewer login against base-repository collaborators with `permissions.push`, using the paginated collaborators API. It says failed authority reads mean STOP.

The **Before dispatch** section then requires applying those author checks before treating a record as an owner. This affects contributor writer handoff after review, not only someone attempting a counted collaborator review.

## Reproduction

Authenticate as an outside contributor without upstream push access, then run:

```sh
gh api --paginate repos/NeoTech/Camcraft/collaborators
```

Actual response, reproduced on November 27, 2026:

```json
{
  "message": "Must have push access to view repository collaborators.",
  "documentation_url": "https://docs.github.com/rest/collaborators/collaborators#list-repository-collaborators",
  "status": "403"
}
```

## Concrete effect

On #4378, the collaborator's code review and local checks passed. The remaining request is to publish existing before/after viewport images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the PR body. The reviewer explicitly released ownership:

- [Review and requested evidence](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4378#issuecomment-7222407129)
- [Reviewer release](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4378#issuecomment-7222411863)

The contributor can read those public records, but the prescribed authority verification fails before recording the next evidence writer. No failed screenshot push or PR-body update is being reported: the stop occurs at the procedural prerequisite.

The same procedure question was already raised for #4238:
[existing contributor clarification request](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4238#issuecomment-7206685402).
It also affects the corrective follow-up described on merged #4319:
[correction notice and writer-procedure question](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4319#issuecomment-7212134672).

## Expected behavior / requested resolution

@mkinney: please document a contributor-compatible way to verify the relevant reviewer authority and resume writer work, or explicitly clarify when a public reviewer result/release allows that handoff without the collaborators API read.

The procedure should preserve the distinction between contributor pre-checks and counted collaborator reviews, and retain the checks for active owners and unexpected remote-head changes.

No upstream write access, counted-review authority or merge permission is requested. The desired fix is a documented contribution procedure that outside contributors can actually follow.
